title: Step
description: A single step in an automation workflow. Represents an operation to execute (e.g., create Jira issue, update Confluence page).

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the automation (e.g., 'step-1', 'create-issue')

type.description: Step type: jira (Jira operation), confluence (Confluence operation), condition (conditional branch), loop (repetition)

config.description: Operation-specific configuration parameters. Schema varies by type and operation.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries (0-5). Default: 0 (no retries).

backoffMs.description: Initial backoff duration in milliseconds (1000-60000). Uses exponential backoff: backoffMs, 2*backoffMs, 4*backoffMs, etc.

onError.description: Error handling strategy: 'fail' (stop run), 'continue' (proceed to next step), 'skip' (skip this step)

timeout.description: Step timeout in milliseconds (10s - 1h). Default: 300000 (5 minutes). If step exceeds timeout, it fails.
